name: Samanea New York Mall
summary: Samanea New York Mall is Long Island's newest lifestyle destination in Westbury, featuring a diverse mix of shopping, international dining along a dedicated restaurant row, and family entertainment venues. Located in Nassau County's premier retail corridor, the center offers a modern, open-air shopping experience that has quickly become a community gathering place.
demographics: Samanea New York Mall attracts a diverse, family-oriented demographic from Nassau County and the broader Long Island area, with a strong representation of middle to upper-middle income households. The trade area encompasses affluent suburban communities in Westbury and surrounding towns, drawing visitors with household incomes ranging from $75,000 to $150,000+. Primary shoppers include families with children seeking entertainment options, young professionals interested in international dining experiences, and home-focused consumers drawn to the furniture and home furnishing retailers. The center's positioning along Old Country Road's iconic retail corridor ensures high visibility and accessibility to Long Island's established shopping population.
description: Samanea New York Mall stands as Long Island's newest premier lifestyle destination, strategically positioned at 1500 Old Country Road in the heart of Westbury, New York. Located in Nassau County's iconic retail corridor, this modern shopping center has transformed the local retail landscape by offering a carefully curated mix of shopping, dining, and entertainment experiences. The center features a diverse tenant roster that includes exciting family entertainment destinations, providing activities for visitors of all ages. A standout feature is the brand-new restaurant row, which showcases international dining options that bring global flavors to Long Island's suburban community. The mall's home furnishing stores cater to design-conscious shoppers looking to elevate their living spaces. With its open-air lifestyle format and contemporary design, Samanea New York has quickly established itself as a go-to destination for Nassau County residents seeking a comprehensive retail and entertainment experience. The center's tagline, "Shop, Dine, Discover," perfectly encapsulates the multifaceted experience awaiting visitors at this dynamic Long Island destination.
